snippet.title: AFL Live 2011 Grand Final - Carlton vs Collingwood
snippet.description:
Gameplay from the PS3 version of AFL Live 2011. This is the Grand Final at the end of a Premiership Season between Carlton (MIGHTY BLUES!) and the dirty scum that is Collingwood. Rightfully Collingwood are thrashed! This is on Amateur Setting.

Apologies for the quality and the skipping in some parts, tried to shrink it down so that you can see what happens before the GF and after you win it!
